title: Passing through a prefilled datepicker must not change the date the form submits
status: Open. Fixes are proposed in pull requests #43150 and #43151, not merged at pinnedCommit. They are never sent to the model.
summary: The datepicker instance is created on focusin and immediately rewrites the input with a locale string, so a saved 2026-10-22 is submitted as 10/22/2026 although the user never picked a date.
expectedBehaviour: Only the part of the issue every proposal agrees on: focusing and leaving the field without picking keeps the submitted value 2026-10-22. What a newly picked date should submit is still being decided upstream and is not tested.
dependencies: dist/css/bootstrap.min.css: the published 6.0.0-alpha.1 stylesheet from npm (MIT)
vendor/vanilla-calendar-pro/index.js: vanilla-calendar-pro 3.4.0 index.mjs from npm (MIT), Bootstrap's peer dependency, mapped with an import map
consumer: Author-written booking change form around the unchanged TypeScript source at pinnedCommit, served with types erased by Node's built-in stripping. Escape closes the calendar because Tab is trapped (see the separate tab-trap case).
